name: Stuffed Zucchini Boats
ingredients: 2 large zucchini, halved lengthways and scooped
1 small onion and 1 tomato, finely chopped
1 tsp cumin and ½ tsp paprika
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Roast the hollowed zucchini halves for 10 minutes.
Chop the scooped flesh. Heat the oil and cook the onion, garlic and zucchini flesh for 5 minutes.
Add the tomato, spices, lentils and tofu and cook for 5 minutes. Season.
Bake for 20 minutes until tender and lightly golden. Finish with parsley.
note: Low in carbohydrate with 19 g protein from lentils and tofu.
